{{Epics Era}} To allow the assassin to slay a prince, and fight his way back out, a fell blade was crafted. It was small enough to conceal under a garment and yet large enough to strike a mortal blow through armor. Aided by vile Teir'Dal enchantments, it is much more fearsome than it appears. -Stanos Herkanor {{Itempage |notes = {{Item Lore|Tainter of Souls}}
